entry.desc: Surface emission file specifiers, one per emission file. Format: 'SPECIES -> FILEPATH' or 'SPECIES -> SCALEFACTOR*FILEPATH' where SPECIES is a registered chemistry constituent name. Example: 'SO2 -> /path/to/emissions_SO2_anthro_surface.nc' Default: none (no surface file emissions).

Type of time interpolation for data in the surface emission files. Can be set to 'CYCLICAL', 'SERIAL', 'INTERP_MISSING_MONTHS', or 'FIXED'. A file carrying the global attribute input_method overrides this setting for that file. Default: 'CYCLICAL'
The cycle year of the surface emission data if srf_emis_type is 'CYCLICAL'. Format: YYYY Default: 0
The date at which the surface emission data is fixed if srf_emis_type is 'FIXED'. Format: YYYYMMDD Default: 0
The time of day (seconds) corresponding to srf_emis_fixed_ymd at which the surface emission data is fixed if srf_emis_type is 'FIXED'. Default: 0 seconds
